intent: Complete finite scientific decision review for an exploratory 3-domain PCC label-stability experiment; a recommendation is not an approval, not a registry selection, and never a real-data fit authorization.

recommendations.rationale: Three distinct application domains, using one grain source (Raisin) rather than Rice plus Raisin. Resource-driven preference for smaller Raisin does not constitute performance-based selection.
recommendations.mandatory_disclosure: Public experimental-dataset descriptions examined in exactly TEN delimited sources (nine published studies plus one arXiv preprint) do not name these three candidates; other historical papers, theses, aliases, local/unpublished MATLAB/Python and collaborators were not exhaustively checked. This is an exploratory study, not a claim that datasets are novel or independently out-of-sample.
needs_human_acknowledgment: Disclose any known earlier local PCC experiments on these datasets; if any, identify them as already-exposed and describe interpretation of P1 outcomes.
Accept that the absence of all undisclosed prior experiments cannot be certified.

recommendations.feature_rule: Use original numeric features; for Wholesale X=Fresh,Milk,Grocery,Frozen,Detergents_Paper,Delicassen, never Region or Channel as predictive feature. UCI metadata lists Region as target, so Channel is a prospectively defined derived task, NOT its default UCI target.
recommendations.provenance_rule: Attribute the CC BY 4.0 UCI sources appropriately, describe clinical patient-origin measurements, grains derived from images, customer spending records; no clinical reidentification or attempts to recover protected IDs.
recommendations.limitations: No subject, grain-acquisition-batch or customer-group IDs are verified; exact numeric duplicate screens and weak Region/Channel association do not establish statistical independence or a patient-level/generalization claim.
needs_human_acknowledgment: Approve/reject the derived Channel task and the three-class Vertebral task.
Accept a strictly descriptive analysis given unavailable verified grouping identifiers, or reject the datasets that do not meet scientific provenance standards.

recommendations.numeric_rule: All source rows in fixed original order. No label-informed feature processing or outlier removal. Apply population per-column z-score with ddof=0 to Vertebral and Raisin. Wholesale: require six nonnegative spending values, apply elementwise log1p, then the same ddof=0 population z-score. Fail closed on unexpected missing/nonfinite or zero-variance features; do not silently exclude rows.
recommendations.transduction: Potential unsupervised use of the entire X is a declared transductive protocol assumption; these transforms must be mathematically fixed before any outcomes, with exact versions and transformed X SHA sealed in later P2.
needs_human_acknowledgment: Approve the log1p + z-score Wholesale transformation and per-column z-scores on other sources, with the transductive all-X scope.
Reject any post-hoc preprocessing changes driven by PCC results.

recommendations.graph: Call unchanged build_knn_graph(X,k_nn=10,metric='minkowski',p=2,n_jobs=1) on transformed X. Preserve undirected symmetric neighbor relationships and deliberately dense ordered neib_list padded with -1. Temporary CSR creation is only an implementation detail of builder, not a propagation-format replacement.
recommendations.integrity_checks: Before first real fit, seal Git source blob and versions, verify no self-loop, symmetry, positive degree, correct actual active edges and exact ordered neighbor/mask/content SHA across backends; NearestNeighbors(algorithm='auto') may vary with tie ordering. Explicitly fix build_graph versus set_graph installation route and any inactive-padding conversion.
needs_human_acknowledgment: Approve k=10 and unchanged production graph builder; any other choice requires prior revised science design.
Accept P2 no-fit graph identity checks as prerequisite and block on disagreement.

recommendations.proposed_work: 3 candidate domains × 8 label masks × 3 backends = 72 fits if later approved and technically feasible; exactly 3 original nodes labeled per class, same source row/order and mask per dataset/replicate across backends.
recommendations.rng: PCG64 SeedSequence([20261112, dataset_registry_index, mask_replicate]) for sorted-class mask sampling, independently domain-separated nonzero uint32 SHA-256 seed per dataset/mask/backend native propagation. No expectation of cross-backend bitwise identity.
recommendations.observation: 50000 iterations, no early stop; observe at [0,1,10,100,1000,5000,25000,50000], primary originally-unlabeled argmax flips at 5000→50000. Report exact tied maxima separately; first-class-index argmax on ties; label/feature/graph/mask hashes must be fixed before outcomes.
needs_human_acknowledgment: Approve 3 labels/class, 8 masks, all native backends, fixed horizon and milestones only after an independent P2 resource budget.
Approve deterministic mask/native-seed recipes and cross-backend pairing on shared graph/mask rather than RNG trajectories.

recommendations.primary: Within each dataset×mask×backend: proportion of initially unlabeled nodes whose predicted argmax class changed at 5000 versus 50000.
recommendations.summary: Disclose every run and failure; per dataset/backend 8-mask values and mean, median, min, max; per backend unweighted average of three dataset means. Do not treat nodes or masks as independent application domains.
recommendations.limits: No CI, significance test, equivalence threshold, generalization claim, performance backend ranking, or stopping-rule optimization based on only 3 deliberately selected domains. Failure/partial execution remains in ledger; do not report unqualified 72-unit summary with missing cases.
needs_human_acknowledgment: Approve an exploratory-only description and limits on claims.
If confirmatory inference is desired instead, design a separate prospectively approved study with independent domains and justified uncertainty.

remaining_nonnegotiable_gates: Maintainer explicitly reviews these six recommendations and acknowledges known unpublished/local prior use and missing patient/customer/batch IDs; no blind/automatic approval.
After scientific decisions, prepare versioned immutable P1 protocol payload and its separate scientific SHA; a draft or source-quality checksum is not a scientific approval.
Before any PCC fit, separate P2 exact-source/native-compiled-binary/environment/mask/graph/resource/output-privacy preflight and distinct P2 SHA.
Actual first-fit execution needs explicit authorization for the approved exact P2 SHA; no output can be retrospectively used to choose the design.
scope_only: NONE of these recommendations or tests certify data independence, establish scientific novelty, or imply permission to run real PCC data.
next_action: Record reviewer approval/rejection or requested changes for S1–S6; only after decisions build frozen P1 protocol and later separately preflight P2. Do not spawn more unbounded historical audits or model runs in this stage.
